observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && for u in "https://lebrel.ai/signup" "https://lebrel.ai/api-keys" "https://lebrel.ai/docs/get-started" "https://nano-gpt.com/api"; do echo "########## $u"; curl -s -o /tmp/x.html -w "%{http_code} " --max-time 25 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "$u"; python3 -c "
import re,html
s=open('/tmp/x.html',errors='ignore').read()
s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); s=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',s,flags=re.S)
s=re.sub(r'<(br|/p|/div|/li|/h[1-6])>','\n',s)
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s)); t=re.sub(r'[ \t]+',' ',t); t=re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+','\n',t)
print(t[:700])
"; echo; done
